about_the_game:
More crystals, spells, wands and fun animations for your RPG! With Wizard Widgets, you’ll have even more resources to activate ancient spells, plot world-shattering events and construct diabolical evils for your villains! Use as progress trackers, points of interest or just a fancy backdrop, all animated, with multiple colors!


The Wizard Widgets Animation Pack Includes:

Magic cauldron (9 colors, plus empty version)
Giant crystal ball (10 colors, plus separated orbs)
Crystal in cage (9 colors, with rising/falling, levitating, glowing animations)
Crystal rising from pit and levitating (9 colors)
Floating/glowing magic wand (Silver and gold bases, 9 colors each, shadow and shadowless version)
Hatch (opening and glowing animation, 9 colors, 1 blank, one with indent)
Extra-large crystal with spin, bob and 2 magical light patterns (9 colors, one solid version, one transparent version)
Magic mirror that opens to a portal (9 colors, gold and silver frames)
Portals/round magic animations (9 colors, 5 styles)
Sparkles (9 colors)
Power fountain with 9 colors in light, 9 colors in dark. Includes flames as a separate animation.
Spell animations (9 colors, with glow, spin, shrink animation patterns)
140+ unique animations!
2000+ animations total!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
